title: tectaria incisa var. pilosa
intro: Tectaria incisa var. pilosa, commonly known as the hairy tectaria fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Tectaria incisa var. pilosa include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
